title: Chirality and non-superposable held orientation
statement: Chirality is the retained distinction between a complete oriented molecular carrier and its exact reflection when exhaustive identity-preserving proper superposition admits no equivalence.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the eight registered binary coordinates; decide every form by complete carrier preservation, exact equivalence enumeration, minimality and absence of an extra rule.
grammar_boundary: Every finite complete three-dimensional chemical structure with named atoms, adjacency, orientation and exhaustive identity-preserving proper maps.

choices.name: formula-only
choices.reason: A formula has no spatial orientation.

choices.name: complete-three-dimensional-object
choices.reason: The full oriented carrier is retained.

choices.name: exact-mirror-image-generated
choices.reason: Reflection is constructed from the same carrier.

choices.name: mirror-composition-changed
choices.reason: The comparison is not reflective identity.

choices.name: all-proper-finite-relabelings-enumerated
choices.reason: Every identity-preserving orientation map is tested.

choices.name: free-chirality-rule
choices.reason: An extra rule can classify anything.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Reflection and exhaustive equivalence decide the class.

induction_base: One oriented structure and its non-superposable reflection supply the first chiral pair.
induction_step: Appending a uniquely labelled oriented branch preserves all prior failed maps and extends the exhaustive map census.
exclusions: no stereochemical dictionary, organic reaction taxonomy, polymer table, biomolecular database, measured target or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no atom, bond, orientation, repeat unit, chain or observation distinction may be created, copied or silently erased
absence is an Empty structural form rather than numerical zero
external target content remains inaccessible until the prediction is sealed
Every finite complete three-dimensional chemical structure with named atoms, adjacency, orientation and exhaustive identity-preserving proper maps.

target_rows.source_locator: authority source set anchored at C01058

falsification_condition: The claim fails if authority evidence lacks reflection, non-superposability, retained chirality or an observation boundary, or if a tampered row is accepted.
